newsitem.title: FRANCE: No change to wheat tax at EU grain tender.
newsitem.headline: No change to wheat tax at EU grain tender.

text.p: The European Union made no change to its wheat export tax at Thursday's weekly grain tender, a European grain official said.
A European Union official earlier did not rule out a cut in the 15 Ecu per tonne tax soon, but declined to say whether it would be as early as today, as some traders had speculated.
Traders have said the tax no longer reflects the market now that world prices have swung lower, and that it should therefore be cut.
